title: 将有序数组转换为二叉搜索树
statement:
给定一个严格递增的整数数组 nums，构造一棵高度平衡的二叉搜索树并返回其根节点，使其中序遍历恰好为 nums。高度平衡指每个节点左右子树的高度差不超过 1。答案可能不唯一，返回任意一棵满足要求的树即可。

节点定义：struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }。输出的树为 LeetCode 层序表示，null 表示空位。

en.title: Convert Sorted Array to Binary Search Tree
en.statement:
Given a strictly increasing integer array nums, build a height-balanced binary search tree whose inorder traversal is exactly nums, and return its root. Height-balanced means the heights of every node's left and right subtrees differ by at most 1. The answer may not be unique; any tree meeting the requirements is accepted.

Node definition: struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }. The output tree uses LeetCode level-order representation, with null marking empty positions.
constraints: 1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10^4; -10^4 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^4; nums is strictly increasing

complexity.space: O(log n) recursion stack (taking the midpoint each time keeps the depth about log n); the n new nodes are output and not counted.
complexity.notes: n is the array length. Using the midpoint of the range as the root and recursing on both sides guarantees balance. The checker accepts any height-balanced BST whose inorder traversal is nums (it need not match the reference answer). The largest local test has n = 10^4. The output is large, so the output limit is raised to 256 KiB.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is n; line 2 has n strictly increasing integers nums. stdout: one line with the level-order tokens of the constructed balanced BST (integers or null, space-separated, trailing nulls omitted). Any valid answer is accepted.

complexity.space: O(log n) 递归栈（每次取中点，深度约 log n）；新建的 n 个节点属于输出，不计入。
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为数组长度。取区间中点为根并递归两侧即可保证平衡。判题器接受任意高度平衡且中序为 nums 的 BST（不要求与参考答案相同）。本地最大测试为 n = 10^4。输出较大，输出上限调至 256 KiB。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 n；第二行 n 个严格递增的整数 nums。stdout：一行，所构造的平衡 BST 的层序 token（整数或 null，空格分隔，省略末尾 null）。任意合法答案均可。
